joinNotice.title: You've been added to {{org}}
joinNotice.auto_join: Your email address matches this organization's sign-in rule, so you were added to {{org}} automatically when you signed in.
joinNotice.invite: You accepted an invitation to {{org}}, so you are now a member.
joinNotice.sandboxIntro: You are on our shared starter instance, in an isolated environment of your own. The sample data is a private copy. Other visitors cannot see what you do here, and nothing here touches anyone else's data.
joinNotice.sandboxOpen: Almost every operation is open to you: register your own sources, model them, write policies and masking rules, and query the result in SQL, GraphQL, or Cypher.
joinNotice.sandboxHeldBack: Org-wide controls are held back: switching or managing environments, inviting people and conferring roles, org settings, and org-wide observability. Those pages stay visible, marked as part of the production system.
joinNotice.sandboxTemporary: Your environment is temporary. Signing out wipes it, and it is also reclaimed after a day of inactivity.
joinNotice.sandboxUpgrade: When you are ready for an organization that persists, upgrade to a Starter plan.
joinNotice.demoSandboxIntro: This sandbox is your own copy of the demo, and a lightweight version of Provisa. These are its limits:
joinNotice.demoSandboxEngine: It runs on a single-process DuckDB engine. Production organizations use a different engine.
joinNotice.demoSandboxMemory: Its engine may use at most {{memory}} of memory; a query that needs more is refused.
joinNotice.demoSandboxDisk: It may hold at most {{disk}} on disk, its data and your uploaded files together; a write past that is refused.
joinNotice.demoSandboxConflicts: Changes made at the same moment from several devices can be refused as a conflict. Try again.
joinNotice.demoSandboxExpires: It is deleted, with everything in it, after {{idle}} without use.
joinNotice.demoSandboxHeldBack: You can't invite people, or switch or manage environments.
joinNotice.demoSandboxSources: The sample sources are read-only, so what you write stays inside the sandbox.
